characterList.description: A middle-aged man with short brown hair and a goatee. He wears glasses and a white collared shirt.
characterList.name: Jared

characterList.description: A toy dog, brown and white, that blows bubbles. It has a red collar and a blue base.
characterList.name: Mits

content_metadata.description: A fun and educational video exploring the concept of gases through demonstrations and experiments.

qAndA.answer: The bubbles sink to the bottom of the tank.
qAndA.question: What happens to the bubbles when Mits first blows them into the empty tank?

qAndA.answer: He mixes vinegar and baking soda.
qAndA.question: What two substances does Jared mix to create carbon dioxide gas?

qAndA.answer: He has Mits blow bubbles into the tank. The bubbles float on a layer of carbon dioxide instead of sinking to the bottom.
qAndA.question: How does Jared demonstrate that carbon dioxide is present in the tank even though it's invisible?

qAndA.answer: The balloons are filled with helium gas, which is lighter than air.
qAndA.question: What gas is inside the balloons, and what property of this gas makes them float?

qAndA.answer: He pushes the balloons down, showing that they resist being compressed, indicating they contain "stuff" that takes up space.
qAndA.question: How does Jared demonstrate that the helium balloons are filled with matter, even though you can't see the helium?
